plan-labels/copilot-free_limited_copilot.reason: An underscore in a plan code reads as a space; Open capitalised the code as Swift does and showed the underscore.

plan-labels/cursor-free_trial.reason: An underscore in a plan code reads as a space; Open capitalised the code as Swift does and showed the underscore.

plan-labels/cursor-pro_plus.reason: An underscore in a plan code reads as a space; Open capitalised the code as Swift does and showed the underscore.

plan-labels/grok-cli-SuperGrok.reason: A plan written in both cases is already a name and keeps its casing; Open lower-cased all but each word's first letter.

plan-labels/grok-cli-supergrok_heavy.reason: An underscore in a plan code reads as a space; Open capitalised the code as Swift does and showed the underscore.

session-title/prompt-crlf.reason: A Windows line break ends the first line. Swift reads \r\n as one character, so Open kept the whole prompt, line break included.

token-format/short-999500.reason: A count that rounds up to the next unit reads in it; Open wrote 1000k.

token-format/short-9999.reason: Ten thousand reads the same whether it is 9,999 or 10,000; Open wrote 10.0k for one and 10k for the other.

token-format/short-999999.reason: A count that rounds up to the next unit reads in it; Open wrote 1000k.

token-format/short-999999999.reason: A count that rounds up to the next unit reads in it; Open wrote 1000M.

plan-labels/claude-max_5x.reason: Anthropic renamed Max 5x to Max on 2026-10-30; the badge follows the vendor's current name.

plan-labels/claude-max_20x.reason: Anthropic renamed Max 20x to Ultra on 2026-10-30; the badge follows the vendor's current name.

plan-labels/claude-MAX_20X.reason: Anthropic renamed Max 20x to Ultra on 2026-10-30; the badge follows the vendor's current name, whatever the code's case.
